title: 第20章 初入五柳城
novel_title: 修炼就修炼，你们别总想留宿啊
content_zh:
从苍梧宗到五柳城，林尘走了三天。

    穿过两片荒林和一条干涸的河床，远远看到城墙的时候他还以为到了落雁谷——城门外立着五棵歪歪扭扭的老柳树，树干上挂满了附近村民系上去的红布条，风吹过来的时候满树的红布条哗啦啦地响。

    进城之后才发现这地方比他待过的任何一座城都热闹。

    街道两边挤满了摆摊的散修和凡人商贩，卖灵药的旁边蹲着卖烤地瓜的，吆喝声此起彼伏。

    灵石在这里不是稀罕物，金丹期修士在街上走也不会有人多看一眼——他在城门口就瞧见两个穿着同款道袍的金丹期修士蹲在路边摊上吃馄饨，其中一个还在跟老板讲价，说你这馄饨肉馅太少不值三颗灵石。

    他在城里转了一圈，先把唐玉的布包和掌门的亲笔信在怀里揣好。

    碎星被陈元带走了，但他在密室里拿回了自己的储物袋——破境丹的蜡封碎片还在里面，御兽残卷也在。

    找了家最便宜的客栈住下，客栈老板娘是个筑基期的散修，看他浑身上下破破烂烂的样子给他开了最角落的一间房，临走时还靠在门框上磕着瓜子说了一句话。

    “城中心广场上有告示栏，贴满了悬赏和招工告示。你要找活干就去那边看看，不过以你的修为最多接一些采药跑腿的活。”

    林尘到告示栏的时候已经围了一圈人。

    大部分是筑基期的散修，也有几个金丹初期的修士在挑挑拣拣。

    告示栏最上面贴着一张血煞宗通缉贺九的悬赏令，画像上的贺九比他本人帅了不少，赏金高得离谱，一看就是血煞宗拿贺九当替罪羊用的。

    下面是各种宗门招工、妖兽材料收购、炼丹师求助手之类的告示，再往下是一些散修发布的私人委托，报酬从灵石到丹药到灵器都有。

    他在告示栏前站了一会儿，目光在其中一张泛黄的告示上停住了——火毒宗叛逃弟子线索悬赏，赏金灵石三百，画像上画的是一个年轻女人，轮廓和唐玉有几分相似，但画得太差了，五官像是用树枝蘸墨随手勾出来的。

    他把告示撕下来折好塞进怀里。

    唐玉已经死了，但火毒宗显然还不知道。

    告示栏最角落里贴着一张手写的求助，“诚聘筑基期以上炼丹师协助炼制解毒丹，报酬面议”，纸条上的字写得很大，但笔锋很抖，纸张边缘还沾着一点干涸的药渍。

    旁边几个散修看了一眼就走开了，一个摆摊卖符纸的散修朝纸条努了努嘴。

    “那是东街徐老头的摊子。徐老头是五柳城资格最老的炼丹师，以前能炼玄阶丹药，后来炼丹炉炸了一次伤了经脉，现在只能炼黄阶下品的丹药混日子。前几天接了一单解毒丹的生意，药材备齐了却发现自己经脉撑不住炼制过程，已经在告示栏贴了好几天了。没人愿意接——不是报酬太低，是徐老头脾气太臭，城里年轻炼丹师都被他骂过，谁也不愿意去挨第二次骂。”

    林尘把纸条撕下来。

    他体内还残留着火棘丹副作用和念毒的混合毒素，掌门的内力压制正在一天天减弱，去落雁谷之前如果能找个炼丹师帮忙调理一下经脉，能多撑几天。

    纸条上说的是“协助炼制”——他不懂炼丹，但解毒丹的药材性质和毒素原理他在密室里被三种毒素折磨了大半个晚上，比任何人都更有发言权。

    东街在五柳城最东边，整条街都是卖药材和丹药的铺子。

    空气里弥漫着一股浓重的药味，路边堆满了晒干的灵草和不知名的妖兽骨骼。

    徐老头的摊子在最深处，一个歪歪扭扭的木棚子下面支着一张破桌子，桌上摆满了瓶瓶罐罐和几本被翻得起了毛边的丹方册子。
content_en:
Lin Chen walked for three days from Cangwu Sect to Wuliu City.

    Passing through two wild forests and a dry river bed, when he saw the city wall from a distance, he thought he was in Luoyan Valley - there were five crooked old willow trees standing outside the city gate, and the trunks were covered with red cloth strips tied by nearby villagers. When the wind blew over, the red cloth strips on the trees rustled.

    After entering the city, he discovered that this place was busier than any other city he had ever stayed in.

    Both sides of the street were crowded with casual cultivators and mortal vendors setting up stalls. Next to those selling elixirs squatted those selling baked sweet potatoes, and shouts could be heard one after another.

    Spirit stones are not a rare thing here, and no one would take a second glance at a Golden Core monk walking on the street - at the gate of the city, he saw two Golden Core monks wearing the same robe squatting at a roadside stall eating wontons. One of them was still bargaining with the boss, saying that your wontons had too little meat filling and were not worth three spiritual stones.

    He walked around the city and first put Tang Yu's cloth bag and the leader's autographed letter in his arms.

    Broken Star was taken away by Chen Yuan, but he got back his storage bag in the secret room - the wax seal fragments of the Breaking Realm Pill were still in it, as were the fragments of the Beast Control Scroll.

    I found the cheapest inn to stay in. The innkeeper's wife was a casual cultivator in the foundation-building stage. Seeing that he was in tatters, she gave him a room in the corner. Before leaving, she leaned on the door frame and cracked melon seeds and said something.

    "There is a notice board in the central square of the city, full of bounties and job recruitment notices. If you want to find work, go there and have a look. But with your cultivation level, you can only accept some medicine-gathering and errand work."

    When Lin Chen arrived at the notice board, there was already a circle of people surrounding him.

    Most of them are casual cultivators in the foundation-building stage, and there are also a few cultivators in the early stage of the golden elixir who are picking and choosing.

    At the top of the notice board was a reward order for He Jiu wanted by the Blood Evil Sect. He Jiu in the portrait was much more handsome than he was in person, and the bounty was ridiculously high. It seemed that the Blood Evil Sect was using He Jiu as a scapegoat.

    Below are notices for recruitment of various sects, purchase of monster materials, alchemists asking for help, etc. Next are some private commissions issued by casual cultivators, with rewards ranging from spiritual stones to elixirs to spiritual weapons.

    He stood in front of the notice board for a while, and his eyes stopped on one of the yellowed notices - there was a reward for clues about the defected disciple of the Fire Poison Sect, and the reward was 300 spiritual stones. The portrait showed a young woman, whose outline was somewhat similar to Tang Yu's, but the painting was so poor that her facial features seemed to have been randomly drawn out with branches dipped in ink.

    He tore off the notice, folded it and stuffed it into his arms.

    Tang Yu is dead, but the Fire Poison Sect obviously doesn't know yet.

    There was a handwritten request for help posted in the corner of the notice board, "We are looking for alchemists above the Foundation Establishment stage to assist in refining detoxification pills. Remuneration is negotiable." The words on the note were large, but the pen was very shaky, and there was still a little dried medicine stain on the edge of the paper.

    Several casual cultivators nearby took one look at it and walked away. A casual cultivator who set up a stall to sell talismans nuzzled at the note.

    "That's Old Man Xu's stall on East Street. Old Man Xu is the oldest alchemist in Wuliu City. He used to be able to make Xuan-level elixirs, but then the alchemy furnace exploded and injured his meridians. Now he can only make low-level Huang-level elixirs to get by. A few days ago, he took on a business of detoxifying pills. I have prepared all the medicinal ingredients, but I found that my meridians can't handle the refining process. It has been posted on the notice board for several days, and no one is willing to take it - it's not that the pay is too low, but that Old Xu has a bad temper. All the young alchemists in the city have been scolded by him, and no one wants to be scolded a second time. "

    Lin Chen tore off the note.

    The mixed toxins of Firethorn Pill and Thought Poison still remain in his body, and the leader's internal pressure is weakening day by day. If he can find an alchemist to help regulate his meridians before going to Luoyan Valley, he can survive for a few more days.

    The note said "Assist in refining" - he didn't know how to make alchemy, but he had been tortured by three toxins in the secret room for most of the night, so he had more say than anyone else about the medicinal properties and toxin principles of the detoxification pill.

    East Street is at the eastern end of Wuliu City. The entire street is filled with shops selling medicinal materials and elixirs.

    There was a strong smell of medicine in the air, and the roadside was piled with dried spiritual herbs and the bones of unknown monsters.

    Old Man Xu's stall is at the deepest part. There is a broken table supported under a crooked wooden shed. The table is filled with bottles and cans and a few rough-edged prescription booklets.
title_en: Chapter 20 Entering Wuliu City for the first time
